name: agentlogin-reference
description: Reference implementation of the Agent Login specification

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/issuer packages/conformance packages/agentlogin packages/rp packages/store-postgres packages/rp-store-postgres packages/mcp packages/agentid-mcp && tsc -p examples/rp-hono/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/issuer/test/*.test.ts packages/agentlogin/test/*.test.ts packages/rp/test/*.test.ts packages/conformance/test/*.test.ts packages/store-postgres/test/*.test.ts packages/rp-store-postgres/test/*.test.ts examples/rp-hono/test/*.test.ts packages/mcp/test/*.test.ts packages/agentid-mcp/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/store-postgres/test/*.test.ts packages/rp-store-postgres/test/*.test.ts examples/rp-hono/test/*.test.ts
